units.title: A. R. Industries
units.intro: A. R. Industries is manufacturing unit 1 of G.M. Consolidated in Kala Amb, Himachal Pradesh — focused on the core assembly of small domestic appliances.
paragraphs: G.M. Consolidated is an appliance design, development and engineering manufacturer established in 1983, with over four decades of experience serving small domestic appliance and personal-care electronics programmes.

The unit operates within the company's integrated manufacturing ecosystem, combining product development, engineering, tooling, manufacturing and quality processes to move programmes from concept to commercial-ready product.
Multi-stage safety and functional inspections keep output dependable, while the company's products are engineered to export-quality baselines.

units.title: Rao Industries
units.intro: Rao Industries is manufacturing unit 2 of G.M. Consolidated in Kala Amb, Himachal Pradesh — focused on water heating systems production.
paragraphs: G.M. Consolidated is an appliance design, development and engineering manufacturer established in 1983, with over four decades of experience serving small domestic appliance and personal-care electronics programmes.

The unit operates within the company's integrated manufacturing ecosystem — combining product development, engineering, tooling, manufacturing and quality processes — with a dedicated focus on water heating appliance systems.
Multi-stage safety and functional inspections support dependable, commercial-ready output engineered to export-quality baselines.
